jobs.title: Associate Accounting (m/w/d)
jobs.reason: An accounting role is well outside the candidate's research/policy profile and skill set — bookkeeping and finance are not areas of demonstrated competence. Nothing hard disqualifies it, but the paper fit and interest alignment are both minimal, so it barely warrants surfacing.

jobs.title: Intern (m/f/d) Carbon Markets & Pricing / International Carbon Action Partnership (ICAP) Secretariat
jobs.reason: This is explicitly an internship for current students, which is excluded as a matter of policy. The topic (carbon markets / climate policy) also sits outside the candidate's core interest zones, but the internship status is the decisive disqualifier.

jobs.title: Wissenschaftliche Museumsassistenz in Fortbildung (w/d/m) im Bereich Kommunikation
jobs.reason: This is an entry-level museum-communications traineeship requiring a completed Master's, which the candidate will have, so it is not disqualified — but it demands demonstrated social-media and press experience, an area the candidate lacks, and the work is comms-focused rather than research. The modern-art / museum-communications field sits outside the candidate's core interest zones, holding the score low despite technical eligibility.

jobs.title: Venture Manager Compute (m/f/x)
jobs.reason: The role requires an established track record at the intersection of entrepreneurship and high-performance/quantum computing or AI, plus experience managing teams and running startup accelerators — a "Professional" career-level position well beyond the candidate's entry-level profile and outside their skills. The deep-tech venture-management focus also sits well outside the candidate's international-law and policy interest zones.

jobs.title: CRM Spezialist (m/w/d) Datenanalyse & Datenqualität
jobs.reason: This is a BI / CRM data-specialist role requiring a degree in business informatics / data science and hands-on experience with Dynamics 365, Power BI, Power Apps, Azure and SQL — a specific technical toolset the candidate's analysis-level SPSS/Python/Excel does not cover, so the paper fit is weak even though not strictly disqualifying. It sits entirely outside the candidate's international-law / geopolitical-risk / research interest zones, in nature-conservation fundraising operations, so interest is minimal.

jobs.title: Studentischer Mitarbeiter (m/w/d) Spendenservice
jobs.reason: This is a Werkstudent (working-student) position, which is excluded as a matter of policy. It also requires enrolment in an economics/business programme and is a donation-service/admin role with no fit to the candidate's profile or interests.

jobs.title: Bibliothekar:in (w/d/m)
jobs.reason: The role requires a completed degree in library and information science (or equivalent library-specific skills) plus hands-on experience with GND, RDA and continuous resources — an essential specialist profile the candidate does not hold. It is also a specialist librarian cataloguing post outside all three interest zones, and effectively requires working with almost exclusively foreign-language (Spanish) materials.

jobs.title: Praktikant (m/w/d) im Themenmanagement der Abteilung Klima, Umwelt, Infrastruktur
jobs.reason: This is explicitly a Praktikum / internship, which is excluded by policy, and it further requires current enrolment or graduation within the last 6 months. The climate/environment development-cooperation focus also sits outside the candidate's core interest zones.

jobs.title: Research Associate for the Project "Cluster of Excellence Understanding Written Artefacts"
jobs.reason: This is a postdoctoral position requiring an already-obtained (or submitted) PhD, which the candidate does not hold — a hard disqualifier. It also requires fluency in Spanish and expertise in precolonial Mesoamerican studies, neither of which the candidate has.

jobs.title: Projektassistenz Organisation & Kommunikation (m/w/d)
jobs.reason: Entry-level and open to a Bachelor's graduate, so eligible on paper, but the role is centred on project administration, event management, social media, and graphic design (Adobe Creative Cloud) — areas that are a partial gap for the candidate and outside their research/writing strengths. Environmental/agricultural project coordination sits outside all three core interest zones, and the comms/design emphasis pulls it further from fit, so it is only marginally worth surfacing.

jobs.title: Manager*in Projektfinanzen Deutsche Programme (d/w/m)
jobs.reason: The role requires "mehrjährige und fundierte Berufserfahrung" (several years of solid experience) in project-finance management, plus accounting knowledge and ERP/CRM systems — a clear post-graduation experience threshold the candidate does not meet, and a "Manager" position outside entry level. It is also a finance/administration role with no connection to the candidate's research or international-law focus.

jobs.title: Studentische Aushilfe Business Development (m/w/d)
jobs.reason: "Studentische Aushilfe" is a working-student / student-assistant side-role, which is excluded as a matter of policy. The business-development focus also sits outside the candidate's core interest zones.

jobs.title: Wissenschaftliche*r Mitarbeiter*in (m/w/d) für das Projekt „Reverse Shot. Bilder deutscher Verbrechen in Europa“
jobs.reason: The posting sets as essential "nachgewiesene mehrjährige Erfahrung" (demonstrated several years' experience) in history didactics on National Socialism, plus proven experience designing mediation projects — a multi-year experience bar the candidate (student-assistant/RA only) cannot meet. It also requires a Master's specifically in history/public history and specialist Nazi-photography didactics expertise. The topic (German atrocities in occupied Europe, memory politics) is genuinely close to the candidate's interests, but the level and specific-experience essentials are hard blockers.

jobs.title: Lohn- und Gehaltsbuchhalter*in (d/w/m)
jobs.reason: This is a payroll accountant role requiring a completed commercial/tax-clerk apprenticeship, relevant payroll experience, and expertise in German tax and social-security law with DATEV Lodas software — none of which the candidate possesses. It is a specialist finance function entirely outside the candidate's research and policy profile and interest zones.

jobs.title: Bibliothekar:in (w/d/m)
jobs.reason: The role requires Spanish at C1 as an essential ("Spanisch- und Englischkenntnisse auf C1"), which the candidate does not have, and it also expects a degree/equivalent experience in library and information science. Both are unmet essentials, and the library-services focus falls well outside the candidate's interest zones.
jobs.salary: Up to Entgeltgruppe 9c TVöD (depending on qualification)

jobs.title: Technische Produktionsassistenz Berlinale (m/w/d/k)
jobs.reason: Disqualified on multiple counts: it requires a completed degree in event/culture management (or equivalent), several years of professional experience in event-safety and technical production, and specialist knowledge of fire/occupational safety and procurement law — none of which the candidate has. The role is also entirely outside all three interest zones.

jobs.title: IT-Projektmanager*in (m/w/d)
jobs.reason: This is an IT project-management role whose essential requirement is concrete, relevant professional experience in IT project management, plus network/IT-security knowledge — a technical operations profile the candidate does not have. Although GFF's human-rights litigation mission is appealing, the role's core skills are outside the candidate's research/policy profile.

jobs.title: Rechtsreferendar*innen (m/w/d) im Legal-Team (Wahl- oder Rechtsanwält*innenstation)
jobs.reason: This placement is reserved for Rechtsreferendar*innen — German legal trainees in the Referendariat after passing the first state law exam — a legal-qualification track the candidate is not on. The strategic-litigation and human-rights work is a strong interest match, but the essential legal-trainee status is an unmet requirement.

jobs.title: Advisor (m/w/d) EU Fisheries
jobs.reason: Requires a degree in fisheries biology/management (or equivalent) plus at least 5 years of professional experience in fisheries and marine policy — both well beyond the candidate's profile and level. This is a mid-to-senior specialist advisory role in a field outside the candidate's interest zones.

jobs.title: Intern (m/f/d) Partnership for Energy Efficiency in Buildings (PEEB)
jobs.reason: This is an internship, which is excluded as a matter of policy regardless of the paid stipend. The topic (energy efficiency in buildings, climate finance) also sits well outside the candidate's core interest zones.
